title: recoverDeployment
summary: Check for a newer deployment after an initial import fails.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Accepts DeploymentOptions or null and an optional destination URL, defaulting to the current location. mountApplication calls this automatically when deployment metadata is supplied.

sections.title: Result
sections.body: Returns a promise of a boolean: true when recovery was requested, false when no reload was permitted. A custom reload callback receives the destination URL.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: For custom bootstraps, call recovery from the initial import failure handler and retain the original failure when no reload occurs. For application mounting, pass metadata before the initial import.

sections.title: Safeguards
sections.body: Null metadata and server rendering are no-ops. Offline, invalid, unchanged or timed-out manifests never reload. A session marker prevents loops; blocked storage disables reload. The original entry script must still be available. Mutations are not replayed.
